summary.text: Sylvia Ortiz-Velez is a Democratic member of the Wisconsin Assembly representing District 8, based in Milwaukee, and has been elected to the Assembly since 2020.
She serves on the Consumer Protection, Housing and Real Estate, and Judiciary committees.

paragraphs.text: Ortiz-Velez was born in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, and is widowed.
She earned a B.A. in political science from the University of Wisconsin-Milwaukee.
The Legislature's page lists her occupation as real estate broker.
